verse.verse_2: And by the Night when it is still,-
verse.verse_3: Thy Guardian-Lord hath not forsaken thee, nor is He displeased.
verse.verse_4: And verily the Hereafter will be better for thee than the present.
verse.verse_5: And soon will thy Guardian-Lord give thee (that wherewith) thou shalt be well-pleased.
verse.verse_6: Did He not find thee an orphan and give thee shelter (and care)?
verse.verse_7: And He found thee wandering, and He gave thee guidance.
verse.verse_8: And He found thee in need, and made thee independent.
verse.verse_9: Therefore, treat not the orphan with harshness,
verse.verse_11: But the bounty of the Lord - rehearse and proclaim!
